---
name: 🔍 Scan a repo
about: Read-only CVE scan of one repo by git-steer. The result is posted here as a comment.
title: "scan "
labels: git-steer-scan
---

Finish the title with the repo to scan, written the way it appears in its GitHub address: the owner, a slash, then the repo name.

git-steer reads the repo through its read-only App, replies here within a few minutes, and closes this issue. Nothing in the repo is changed.
